name: @orbb/auth
description: Identity boundary for ORBB (architecture §3 A22 + A25): opaque session tokens (hashed-at-rest, injectable clock/id/store), dependency-free WebAuthn passkey verification (L3 shapes, trust-ignored attestation), single-use email OTP with attempt counting and platform-RateLimiter resend throttling, single-use recovery codes, the Upstash REST rate-limit adapter (shape-verified, not live-verified), and account lifecycle seams against the @orbb/db repository shapes. Zero runtime package dependencies: all crypto is node:crypto.
